copy.headline: Specialist teaching support
copy.introduction: Providing expert teaching support tailored for dyslexia, along with personalised tutoring in English and maths to help primary children build confidence and succeed.

reviews.name: Jasveer Kooner
reviews.quote: Julie has been the most professional and reliable tutor we have worked with. Our 11 year old son looks forward to learning with her.

reviews.name: Amy Nickols
reviews.quote: Julie has been a great addition to our child’s learning. He has gained so much confidence from going to Julie!

reviews.name: Megan North
reviews.quote: Julie has been an amazing support in building our daughter’s confidence in her work and in herself.

reviews.name: Eleanor Clark
reviews.quote: Julie has been fantastic with my AuDHD daughter. In one term she has a much better grounding in French — and more confidence too.

reviews.name: Dorothy Martin
reviews.quote: Julie has taught our KS2 child for over a year — experienced, patient, and understands the challenges dyslexic pupils face.
